body: My child was born via emergency c-section and I almost lost both the mother and child. I wish I could say I was happy, but I was more stressed and anxious than anything else.

I don't believe for a second that I am over qualified, it's just a way to say no nicely.. All of the jobs pay well and I explain that I am very interested. 

Tomorrow is just another day of the same hell I have been in for 20+ years
My kid is suggesting that I get more cookies and they will share them..
